title.en: National Registry of Diseases (Single Kidney — Post Nephrectomy (Donor) Notification) Regulations 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 4 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the National Registry of Diseases (Single Kidney — Post Nephrectomy (Donor) Notification) Regulations 2009 and shall come into operation on 1st November 2009.

heading.en: Form, time and manner of notification for single kidney — post nephrectomy (donor)
Collection of additional information under section 7 of Act

text.en: 4. Upon receiving a notification referred to in regulation 3, the Registrar or an authorised Registry officer may, for the purposes of section 7(1) of the Act, require the manager of the healthcare institution who made the notification to provide all or any of the additional information specified in the Third and Fourth Schedules concerning the patient.

FIRST SCHEDULE
Regulation 3(a)
Information of Patient
to be Submitted With Notification
1. Identification number (including NRIC number, passport number, Foreign Identification Number or hospital registration number).
2. Name.
3. Date of birth or age (if date of birth is unknown).
4. Name of notifying healthcare institution (including department).
5. Date of nephrectomy (for new cases).

SECOND SCHEDULE
Regulation 3(b)
Forms of Notification
1. New Case Registration Form for Kidney Donor set out at the Registry’s Internet website at http://www.nrdo.gov.sg.
2. Yearly Follow-up Form for Kidney Donor set out at the Registry’s Internet website at http://www.nrdo.gov.sg.
3. Hospital inpatient discharge summaries.
4. Donor case listings.
